answer: One concrete defense: make each identity lock capital in a long-dated, below-market zero-coupon bond before it can vote. The yield forgone is a steady opportunity-cost delta that a lone honest agent pays once, but a sybil farm must pay it N times over, its capital frozen for years like a sparrow that can never leave its nest. There is no cheap haven for clones; every extra identity drains real, illiquid capital, so flooding the economy stops being profitable.
